response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is the Hive itself, which HiveRepository stores as HiveRecord entries ("private readonly items = new Map<string, HiveRecord>();"). B is the Hive Scale, a separate weighing device modelled as ScaleRecord. ScaleService keeps its own ScaleRepository (findByHive, findBySerial, save) and links scales to hives through HiveRepository.findById and ScaleService.linkScale. So a scale is a separate thing that belongs to a hive and has its own serial number and weight readings. It is not another name for the hive.
